name: R004-dewgong-encore-roll
why: Challenge 7. The opponent leads Dewgong (set 488: Blizzard, Double-Edge, Encore, Disable; speed 90). The player leads Registeel (set 764: Metal Claw, Curse, Amnesia, Rest; speed 70, so not faster than Dewgong); Steel resists both Blizzard and Double-Edge. Registeel uses Amnesia every turn (it fails at +6 but is still its last move) with a Rest now and then; both effects are in AI_CV_Encore_EncouragedMovesToEncore. So every AI turn from turn 2 on, while no move of Registeel is disabled, AI_CV_Encore reaches the <30 roll of AI_CV_Encore2 (about 12 percent per turn): the jump to End is the runCvEncore branch. Dewgong's Disable turns take the other route; Encore on Registeel does not stop the scoring. The player never attacks, so Dewgong stays in for some 25 turns.
